Portable project grid

Knowledge checkpoint

Understand

  • Explain the central idea.
  • State an important limit.

Practise

  • Apply it to one example.
  • Record a follow-up question.

A checkpoint should reveal what the reader can do now.

Decision trail

  1. Constraint — preserve a readable publishing flow without adding a page-builder runtime.
  2. Decision — use portable core blocks and contextual presentation instead of a custom project model.
  3. Consequence — content remains editable and transferable while the theme owns only presentation.

Evidence

Attach a benchmark, artifact, observation, or shipped result that supports the decision.

Procedure with verification

Goal

State the observable end condition before the reader begins.

  1. Prepare the minimum input.
  2. Perform the action and observe its signal.
  3. Verify the result before continuing.

Verify

  • Confirm the expected output.
  • Identify the first failed signal before repeating the task.
